name: Anchor
author: Ryan Ghods
description: Portfolio pulse, incoming offers and closing deadlines from Anchor's local read-only data service

barWidget.description: Portfolio value, incoming offers, closing deadlines and recent activity, read from Anchor's local data service on loopback. Read-only: it never signs, writes or holds a key.

schema.label: Service port
schema.description: Loopback port Anchor's data service listens on. Must match `port` in ~/.config/anchor/config.json.

schema.label: Change over
schema.description: Window the percentage change is measured across.

schema.label: Show portfolio value
schema.description: Show the portfolio value on the bar. Turn off to keep the number off it while screen sharing; the value stays available in the panel.

schema.label: Show the change
schema.description: Add the percentage change beside the value. Off by default — the bar starts sparse and you add what you want, from the panel's details view or here.

schema.label: Show the offer count
schema.description: Add the number of incoming offers. Off by default; the panel always lists them.

schema.label: Show the next countdown
schema.description: Add the countdown to the next offer that closes. On by default — it is the only bar item with a clock running out.

schema.label: Show the activity count
schema.description: Add the number of events in the activity window. Off by default; it needs no decision.

schema.label: Deadline window (hours)
schema.description: Only count down offers closing within this many hours. Further out is not news.

schema.label: Urgent within (hours)
schema.description: A countdown inside this window is drawn in the theme's attention colour.

schema.label: Name length
schema.description: Characters of a collection or item name to show before truncating.

schema.label: Activity window (hours)
schema.description: How far back the activity count on the bar looks.

schema.label: Call it stale after (seconds)
schema.description: A reading older than this is shown as stale even if the service has not said so.

schema.label: Read timeout (seconds)
schema.description: How long a read waits for the local service before it counts as a failure.
